{{Top|leg}}
'''Clingsilk''' was a material used to make clothing. The [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jenet/Legends|Jenets]] who worked a private lounge in the [[Aquarium Room]] of the [[Pearl Island Casino]] wore clingsilk skirts along with backless blouses.<ref name="TTWS">{{InsiderCite|67|The Trouble with Squibs}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Author [[Troy Denning]] introduced clingsilk in his short story "[[The Trouble with Squibs]]," first published in [[Star Wars Insider 67|''Star Wars Insider'' 67]] in [[May]] [[2003]]. The story was later reprinted in [[October]] [[2005]] on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] website.
